## Summary

- Drop source-inferred `base_pr` metadata when the source PR is closed or merged so `/implement` starts from the default branch while retaining PR context.
- Add a base-branch note to generated tracking issue metadata and clarify explicit closed `base_pr` resolver errors.
- Update prompt/docs and regression tests for open vs closed inferred base PR handling.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #322 addresses issue #305, which is part of parent issue #314’s batch of small fixes. It prevents explicit `/implement` requests made from closed or merged PRs from carrying that source PR forward as an inferred `base_pr`. The implementation keeps the closed PR as tracking-issue context while letting the implementation start from the repository default branch. It also preserves open inferred base PR behavior, improves the explicit closed-base error, and updates docs, prompt guidance, and regression tests.

## Review
The current review artifacts and PR diff support shipping this change. Reviewers did not identify any blocking or warning-level issues; the only optional notes were minor INFO observations that do not require branch changes.
